_readme: Hub assistant tool switches (phase 1a, Mark 3 Nov 2026). Copy to config/assistant.json (git-ignored) to change them on this machine. This file can only SWITCH A TOOL OFF (enabled false) or NARROW its audience; it can never add a tool or widen one - the approved list is in hub/assistant/registry.py (APPROVED_TOOLS). audience: mark = Mark only. On/off for the whole assistant, the key, the ledger and the monthly cap stay in config/lenschat.json.
